vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: macro-helper
Version: 2.2.0

The macro-helper skill bundle is a legitimate tool designed to assist users with Excel VBA programming. The core logic in scripts/macro.sh functions as a static template engine, providing boilerplate code, debugging tips, and optimization advice without any network activity, file exfiltration, or unauthorized command execution. All instructions in SKILL.md and tips.md are consistent with the stated purpose of generating and explaining VBA macros.

llm.summary: The skill is internally consistent with its stated purpose (an Excel/VBA helper): it only provides scripts and templates for generating/explaining/debugging VBA code and requests no extra credentials or installs.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the provided assets: SKILL.md, tips.md, and scripts/macro.sh all generate, explain, debug, template, convert, and optimize VBA macros. No unrelated binaries, env vars, or services are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are limited to running the included bash script which prints VBA code, explanations, and templates. The generated VBA legitimately includes file operations, Outlook email automation, and workbook attachment examples — these are expected for an Excel macro helper but are dangerous if the generated macro is run without inspection. The skill does not itself read local files, exfiltrate data, or contact remote endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install specification; this is instruction-only plus a bundled script. Nothing is downloaded or extracted from external URLs and no installers are invoked.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables, credentials, or config paths are requested. The examples referencing Outlook, file paths, and ThisWorkbook are appropriate for VBA templates and do not require platform-level secrets from the skill.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not force-included (always:false) and does not request persistent system privileges or modify other skill configurations. Autonomous invocation is allowed by default but is not combined with other concerning factors.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says: produce/explain/diagnose VBA macros. Before using generated macros, inspect the code carefully (especially any .Send, .Attachments.Add, Workbooks.Open, file deletions, or external process calls). Disable or carefully manage macros in production workbooks, test generated code in a copy/sandbox Excel file, and change any placeholder email addresses or file paths. If you don't trust the source, avoid running macros that send files or perform file-system operations.
